Custom Homes in Central Texas

Design and build your dream home with five generations of Central Texas craftsmanship. We handle everything—including roofing, painting, and finishes—from concept to keys with transparent budgeting and attention to detail.

What We Handle

  • Thoughtful design tailored to your lifestyle and the Texas climate
  • High-quality materials and finishes that last
  • Roofing, painting, and exterior finishes
  • Energy-efficient construction practices
  • Clear communication and realistic timelines
  • Full coordination of all trades and inspections

Local Considerations

We build with Bell County realities in mind: clay soils require proper foundations, high heat calls for good insulation and ventilation, and storm season means durable roofs and impact-resistant features. Our homes are designed to perform for generations.

Our Process

  1. Initial consultation and site evaluation
  2. Design collaboration and budgeting
  3. Permitting and pre-construction
  4. Building with regular updates and site access
  5. Final walkthrough, punch list, and warranty

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a custom home take? Typically 9–18 months from start to finish, depending on size, complexity, and material availability. We provide clear, realistic timelines upfront.

Can you build on my lot? Yes. We evaluate soil, drainage, and access during planning.

Do you offer design services? We work with your architect or can recommend trusted designers.

Do you build energy-efficient homes? Yes. We incorporate insulation, windows, and systems to reduce long-term energy costs.
